header.name: Workcenter
header.description:
This table lists workcenters and it's attributes
Links out to workcenter source location, work order process distribution and, product setup material

modelDefinition.name: Workcenter

fields.name: id
fields.description: The primary unique ID of the record.  Every model should have an id field.

fields.name: concurrency
fields.description: The Maximum Concurrent Operations that can Run -- Defaulted to 1 (REQUIRED, DEFAULT = 1)

fields.name: hourlyLaborCost
fields.description: What is the hourly labor cost? (REQUIRED, DEFAULT = 0)

fields.name: hourlyOverheadCost
fields.description: What is the hourly overhead cost? (REQUIRED, DEFAULT = 0)

fields.name: hourlySetupCost
fields.description: What is the hourly setup cost? (REQUIRED, DEFAULT = 0)

fields.name: productionOperators
fields.description: Number of Production Operators required when performing a setup change on this workcenter. This is ONLY used if "use workcenter rates" is true on the PSP.

fields.name: setupOperators
fields.description: Number of Setup Operators required when performing a setup change on this workcenter. This is ONLY used if "use workcenter rates" is true on the PSP.

fields.name: setupRate
fields.description: This is a global setupRate for this workcenter - this is ONLY used if the flag "use Workcenter Rates" is true, on the PSP.

fields.name: standardRate
fields.description: Standard Rate of Units/hour production - this is ONLY used if "use Workcenter Rates" is true on the PSP.

fields.name: active
fields.description: System flag indicates whether the workcenter is active (REQUIRED, DEFAULT = TRUE)

fields.name: certification
fields.description: Certification when true - will require all production employees to have a certification on record in Fuuz in order to be clocked in when the production run begins.

fields.name: constraint
fields.description: Mark true if this resource is a constraint. This will create the necessary calendar resource objects allowing this resource to be evaluated during a scheduling run. If false, this resource will not be evaluated as a scheduling constraint.

fields.name: customData
fields.description: A collection of extra data points that can vary depending on the source of the workcenters.

fields.name: putAwayLocationId
fields.description: Default location to put away inventory produced at this workcenter

fields.name: distributions
fields.description: Link to work order process ditribution

Links out to workcenter source location, work order process distribution and, product setup material
